# NeurusAGi

> NeurusAGi is an artificial general intelligence platform focused on reasoning, research, creative work, and task-oriented assistance.

## About

NeurusAGi publishes information about its platform, artificial general intelligence, AI research, innovation, safety, ethics, education, work, and related questions. Public pages are available for reading and linking. Claims about the platform are the publisher's descriptions and should be evaluated as such.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://neurusagi.com/): Platform overview, mission, origin story, architecture, capabilities, and early-access calls to action.
- [About](https://neurusagi.com/about): Mission, core capabilities, advanced intelligence features, technology descriptions, and product positioning.
- [News & Insights](https://neurusagi.com/news): Searchable index of articles by Jeremy Taylor.
- [Pricing](https://neurusagi.com/pricing): Public plan names, prices, usage descriptions, and plan features.
- [Pre-Sale](https://neurusagi.com/presale): Public pre-sale plan information and month-selection flow.
- [Investor Relations](https://neurusagi.com/investors): Investor overview and inquiry form.
- [Contact](https://neurusagi.com/contact): General, media, and support contact form.

## Private areas

The dashboard, administration dashboard, and account onboarding are private application areas. They are not public sources and are marked noindex.
